title: Client contradicts themselves on priority
transcript:
Consultant: How do you want to capture how urgent a case is?
Client: We need a priority field on the case. Make it a picklist with low,
medium and high.
Consultant: Understood, a picklist on case.
Client: Actually, scratch that. The priority on the case has to be a number
from one to five, because our SLA engine sorts on it numerically.
Consultant: Those are two different field types for the same field. Which one?
Client: Honestly, I need to check with the SLA team before we commit.

expected.note: The numeric statement. Both should be extracted; neither should be silently dropped.

notes: Both statements must survive extraction and both must be flagged. The detector proves this one: same object and field, incompatible types.
